case_name: Minnesota Voters Alliance v. Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State
proposed_holding: Because Minnesota Rule 8210.2450, subpart 3 (2021), authorizes any ballot board member to review signatures in the event of an identification number mismatch and Minn. Stat. § 203B.121, subd. 2(b)(3) (2022), requires that election judges conduct that review, the rule conflicts with the statute.
proposed_civic_relevance: This ruling invalidated an administrative rule from the Secretary of State, stripping non-election judge ballot board members of the authority to verify signatures on absentee ballots. It directly impacts the integrity and procedural handling of absentee ballots in Minnesota.
operator_claim_note: The numerical claim regarding over 1.2 million absentee voters is excluded from canonical admission until independently sourced.
